rows.commentary: 0.1: Naman Ojha does not score off Hilfenhaus.

Yuvraj is lighting up the crease for INDCH, dispatching the last two deliveries into the stands with absolute disdain!

15.1: D Arcy Short floats it up and Pathan launches it high and handsome, clearing the ropes for six authoritative runs deep over mid-wicket.

16.1: Hilfenhaus delivers to Yuvraj, who lofts it with immense power all the way over deep extra cover for a maximum.
16.2: Hilfenhaus strays just enough and Yuvraj deftly guides it fine past the fielder down to third man for a cracking boundary.
16.3: Hilfenhaus attacks the stumps again and Yuvraj pushes it firmly into the cover region to comfortably pick up a single.
16.4: Hilfenhaus drops it short and Pathan swivels, pulling it menacingly over backward square leg and all the way for six.

17.1: Fawad Ahmed deceives Irfan Pathan in the flight, and Ben Dunk whips off the bails in a flash to complete a sharp stumping.
17.2: Fawad Ahmed floats it up to Rishi Dhawan, who taps it softly toward backward point to collect a sharp single.
17.3: Fawad Ahmed strikes as Yuvraj holes out to Wells, ending a blistering 71 off 44 balls featuring five fours and six maximums.
17.4: Fawad Ahmed delivers to Chawla, who pushes it away towards backward point for a single.
17.5: Fawad Ahmed floats it up, Rishi Dhawan guides it deftly down to third man for a single.
17.6: Chawla does not score off Fawad Ahmed.
Fawad Ahmed strikes twice in the over, claiming his second wicket to leave INDCH struggling at 161 for 6!
18.1: Coulter-Nile charges in at the death, sliding a full delivery into Rishi Dhawan who pushes it firmly toward the cover region for a sharp single.
18.2: Coulter-Nile keeps attacking the stumps, and Chawla smartly works this length ball out into the deep sweeper cover area to rotate the strike.
18.3: Coulter-Nile misses his mark just a fraction, and Rishi Dhawan punishes it with a colossal swing, launching the white ball high and handsome over the long-on boundary for a maximum.
18.4: Coulter-Nile arcs it into the slot, and Rishi Dhawan launches it towering and clean over long-on for a maximum.
18.5: Coulter-Nile drops it into the arc, and Rishi Dhawan launches it towering over deep mid-wicket for a massive six!
18.6: Coulter-Nile finishes the over by darting it in, and Rishi Dhawan pushes it down to long-on for a single.
19.1: No run for Rishi Dhawan off K Richardson.

19.4: Richardson keeps it tight, angling this full delivery into Rishi Dhawan, who works it away briskly towards mid-wicket for a single.
19.5: Richardson delivers, Chawla scrambles for the second, and Usman Khawaja swoops from the outfield to catch him short of the crease with a pinpoint throw!
19.6: Richardson steams in for the final ball, but Dhawan dispatches it cleanly to the deep extra cover fence for four.
0.1: Mohit Sharma delivers, and D Arcy Short launches it high and handsome into the deep extra cover stands for a maximum.

0.6: Dot ball from Mohit Sharma to Ben Dunk.
INDCH have swung the match their way, leaving AUSCH at 11 for 1 after 0.4 overs, needing 185 more to win!
